whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Sweet Home,

I noticed your bakery has strong 4.1★ reviews with 630+ happy customers near the Boring Road crossing in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct cake and custom pastry orders.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme instant WhatsApp cake booking, menu showcase, aur special occasion delivery inquiries integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sweethome

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sweet Home Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke popular bakery store (Sweet Home) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your prominent Boring Road location visibility. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual product menu aur prices integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
